'''Pallet Town''' (Japanese: '''マサラタウン''' ''Masara Town'') is a small town located in southwestern [[Kanto]]. It is the [[hometown]] of the {{player}} and their [[rival]] in the Kanto-based {{pkmn|games}}. In other games, it is specifically the hometown of {{ga|Red}} and {{ga|Blue}}. In {{aniseries|PTS}}, it is the hometown of {{Ash}} and {{Gary}}. [[Professor Oak's Laboratory]], where the famous [[Professor Oak]] conducts his research, is located in the town.

The town has two exits. To the north is {{rt|1|Kanto}}, leading to [[Viridian City]]. To the south is {{rt|21|Kanto}}, a [[water route]] leading to [[Cinnabar Island]].
